sources.title: GitHub - azaleadj/cube_yolo: YOLOv8-based real-time Rubik’s Cube ...
sources.snippet: Rubik’s Cube Detection using YOLOv8 This project trains a custom YOLOv8 model to detect Rubik’s Cubes in real-time using a camera feed. It includes both model training and live object detection code, and can be connected to a robot for further manipulation tasks.
